posts.title: The Founder Shouldn’t Be the Bottleneck
posts.description: Adding AI builders speeds up nothing while the founder is the bottleneck, because every question and handoff still ends at the founder’s desk. Here is how I run Tapestry with parallel builders and a technical program manager, what the repository records show, and what I have not established.

posts.title: The Only Alpha You Fully Control
posts.description: Most people apply their alpha framework to their portfolio and never to the decade of execution they commit to their own career. Equity is the instrument that lets that bet compound.

posts.title: US-China: One Collision, Many Surfaces
posts.description: Every headline about chips, rare earths, cyber, and payments is a surface of the same structural collision. Reading them as one changes which bets make sense.
